# LingQ

> LingQ is a content-based language learning platform offering immersive education in 52 languages through real-world content like podcasts, books, and TV shows.

LingQ provides multilingual learning experiences across 18+ language interfaces, founded on the principle of acquiring vocabulary and grammar naturally through engaging, authentic content. The platform combines brain science-based methodology with a free trial to help learners achieve fluency across a diverse range of languages.

## Key Topics

- Content-based learning
- Immersive method
- 52 languages
- Vocabulary building
- Real content (podcasts, books, TV)
- Multilingual platform
- Language app
- Free trial
- Online education
- LingQ Method
- Progress tracking
- Language acquisition
- Brain science-based learning
- Authentic materials
- Fluency development

## Main Platform

- [Learn Languages Online with Real Content | LingQ Language App](https://www.lingq.com/en): LingQ homepage: Learn languages from podcasts, books, TV shows
- [About LingQ - Meet the team that makes it happen](https://www.lingq.com/en/about): About LingQ: Company philosophy and team (Kaufmann, Franco, Dobroslavov)

## Language Portals

- [Lernen Sie Sprachen online mit echtem Inhalt | LingQ Sprach-App](https://www.lingq.com/de): LingQ German homepage: 52 languages, content-based learning
- [Apprenez les langues en ligne avec du contenu réel | Application LingQ Language](https://www.lingq.com/fr): LingQ French homepage: Natural learning from real content
- [Aprenda Línguas Online com Conteúdo Real | Aplicativo de Idiomas LingQ](https://www.lingq.com/pt): LingQ Portuguese homepage: Immersive language learning with books
- [リアルなコンテンツでオンライン言語学習 | LingQ 言語アプリケーション](https://www.lingq.com/ja): LingQ Japanese homepage: Vocabulary building from real content
- [通过真实内容在线学习语言 | LingQ 语言应用程序](https://www.lingq.com/zh-cn): LingQ Simplified Chinese homepage: Immersive content-based learning
- [使用真實內容在線學習語言 | LingQ語言應用](https://www.lingq.com/zh-tw): LingQ Traditional Chinese homepage: 52 languages with progress tracking
- [진짜 콘텐츠로 온라인에서 언어 배우기 | LingQ 언어 앱](https://www.lingq.com/ko): LingQ Korean homepage: Multilingual learning with free trial
- [Изучайте языки онлайн с реальными материалами | Приложение для изучения языков LingQ](https://www.lingq.com/ru): LingQ Russian homepage: Immersion method with real content
